question: Does the original carrier/family packet formula accept the source U(1) charge in the s- and c-frames, and does the Ward normalisation select the family lift?
summary_de: Q'=2(e3+e6) ist 2*lambda_A des Minimalpakets m_A=(0,0,-1,-1). Mit der urspruenglichen Clutching-Richtung e_weak folgt aus q=k*lambda_m und |q|^2=8 zwingend k=2, m=m_A (Normminimum aus Ward-Normierung statt Zusatzvertrag); bei beliebigen Traegerrichtungen weitere Loesungen. Codex' c-Rahmen-Bild (-1,-1,2,0,0;1,-1,0) hat spurfreien Traeger und passt fuer kein m; benoetigte Zusatz-Familienwirkung (0,1,-1,0) wird von den Originalen nicht geliefert (SU(3)-Flavormonodromie hat Z3-Gewichte).
kills: The c-frame image of the source charge satisfies the original packet formula for some lift m
The minimal lift m_A needs an independent norm-minimum contract once q = k lambda_m with the original clutching direction is granted
assumptions: Packet formula A_W = rho(A_E) x I4 + I16 x M_m tr A_E (original contract)
Explicit identifications x = e_weak and q = k lambda_m (the determinant class alone does not fix e_weak, archive02:1896-1974)
c-frame image supplied by Codex with the old exact matrix M
not_derived: The Ward identification q = k lambda_m from the seam
An independent family cocharacter (0,1,-1,0) from the original sources
